purpose: Cloudflare DNS automation with reviewed change plans, readback checks and a source-cited knowledge vault.

discovery.setup: Python 3.10+. Offline doctor needs no credentials. Live operations require CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN scoped to the selected zones; writes require explicit zone and preview-hash confirmation.
discovery.not_for: Registrar transfers, registrar nameserver changes, Workers deployments, tunnels, bulk writes, or an MCP server.
examples: Preview a DNS change before applying it
Prepare a DNS hosting migration checklist

scope: Portable Python CLI for zones, DNS inventory, nameservers, preview-first single-record upsert and exact-ID deletion. Obsidian-compatible knowledge vault and private Empire templates.
